definitions.explanation: Describes a reaction or response that happens instantly and without conscious thought, like a physical reflex.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反射的|はんしゃてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{向|む}いた→振り向く：04232_furimuku⟧。
examples.english: I reflexively turned around at the loud noise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反射的|はんしゃてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}ろう→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When people sense danger, they instinctively try to protect themselves.

notes:
{反射的|はんしゃてき} describes reactions that happen instantly and involuntarily — like a reflex. From ⟦{反射|はんしゃ}→反射：08390_hansha⟧ (reflection/reflex) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix).

FORMS:
- {反射的|はんしゃてき}な + noun: reflexive (modifier)
- {反射的|はんしゃてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: reflexively, instinctively (adverb — most common form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反射的|はんしゃてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to move reflexively
- {反射的|はんしゃてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧: to answer instinctively
- {反射的|はんしゃてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}を{引|ひ}く→身を引く：20072_miwohiku⟧: to flinch reflexively
- {反射的|はんしゃてき}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: reflexive behavior

USAGE:
Describes both physical reactions (flinching, dodging, turning around) and verbal responses (blurting something out). Always implies the action was not deliberate.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本能的|ほんのうてき}→本能的：06260_honnouteki⟧: instinctive (driven by innate instinct, not necessarily fast)
- ⟦{無意識|むいしき}→無意識：05813_muishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: unconsciously (broader — can include habits, not just reflexes)
